rec.name: Sub-Collection Bubble Navigation Bar
rec.status: Built — delivered to Yaadu (first Sectionfy.io customer), customer satisfied

what.text: A horizontal row of round (or square) image thumbnails with short labels, placed directly under the header and above the hero banner. Each bubble links to a sub-collection or category (e.g. Lexikon, Traditional Lid, Flat Lid – Large, Sets, Deko, Blankets). The row is centered on desktop, and the bubbles shrink on mobile. The ticket is really a bundled Sectionfy order (teaser texts, product badges via metaobjects, video play button, benefits, installment/invoice payment info, info buttons, cart upsell, shop benefits). Only this section is documented visually, so this record covers only it.

why.text: Visual category shortcuts cut the number of clicks from landing page to the relevant product range. Image-based labels are processed faster than text menus, so shoppers recognise categories at a glance. This lowers choice friction and bounce on the landing page, and it surfaces niche sub-categories that a dropdown menu hides.

how.text: Add the Sub-collections section to the Home (or collection) template, directly below the header. Add one block per sub-collection, each with an image, a label and a collection link. Choose the 'Show bubbles' style, circle or square images, and size, colour and gap settings for desktop and mobile. Set Positioning to 'Static' so the bar sits above the banner as its own row. 'Absolute' overlays the bar on top of the hero banner, which in this store made the customer's banner disappear behind the bar. Make sure the bar is centered on desktop.

items: Blocks: one per sub-collection (image, label, link)

dependencies.text: Implemented in the customer's conrise-theme-2 theme (not Focal), which needed extra adaptation time. It also lives in the Sectionfy theme as a template. The Sectionfy library sections need access to the store's products and metafields. Other sections in the same order (product badges) rely on metaobjects. This section needs collection images for the bubbles, and I assume it does not need metafields.

metrics: Share of sessions entering a collection page from the bar
Revenue per session and conversion rate (mobile vs desktop)

images.caption: Theme editor: Sub-collections section with bubble blocks and settings (style, sizes, colors, gaps, Static/Absolute positioning)
Live desktop result: centered row of labeled circular sub-collection bubbles under the header, above the hero banner
